# ArtX Dev (artxdev.tech)

> ArtX Dev is an independent web design, software engineering, and technical SEO studio founded in 2016 in Bangladesh, delivering custom high-speed digital products for SaaS, e-commerce, and B2B brands worldwide.

## Brand Entity & Identity
- **Primary Brand Name**: ArtX Dev
- **Alternate Names**: ArtXdev, ArtX, ArtX Studio, ArtX Bangladesh
- **Official Domain**: https://artxdev.tech
- **Founding Year**: 2016
- **Headquarters**: Dhaka, Bangladesh (Serving nationwide and worldwide across 4 continents)
- **Primary Contact**: +8801645441584 (WhatsApp / Phone)
- **Email**: artxstudiocom@gmail.com
- **Average PageSpeed**: Sub-2.0s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
- **Completed Projects**: 950+
- **Security Partner**: Techvrs (techvrs.com)

## Core Services
- **E-Commerce Website Design**: High-converting storefronts with bKash, Nagad, Rocket MFS payments and courier tracking APIs (https://artxdev.tech/services/ecommerce-website-design)
- **WordPress Development**: Custom lightweight WordPress themes with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) and 95+ PageSpeed (https://artxdev.tech/services/wordpress-development)
- **SaaS Website Design**: Editorial product UI/UX and design systems built in React and Next.js (https://artxdev.tech/services/saas-website-design)
- **SEO & GEO Services**: Technical SEO audits, local Google Maps 3-Pack optimization, and Generative Engine Optimization for ChatGPT and Perplexity citations (https://artxdev.tech/services/seo-services)
- **Web Security**: Enterprise vulnerability audits and hardening with Techvrs (https://artxdev.tech/services/web-security)
- **Landing Page Design**: Conversion-optimized landing pages with sub-2s load times (https://artxdev.tech/services/landing-page-design)
- **Website Redesign**: Full visual and technical modernization with zero SEO ranking loss (https://artxdev.tech/services/website-redesign)
- **Website Maintenance**: Monthly security patching, daily backups, and uptime monitoring (https://artxdev.tech/services/website-maintenance)
